# AIO Fusion

> AIO Fusion is a web-based Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) platform combining brand-visibility audits with communications planning, content work, media research and reporting.

## Audiences

- PR and communications agencies managing client projects.
- In-house communications and marketing teams coordinating a brand's programme.

## Core capabilities and measurement coverage

- **Auditing:** Earned Media Visibility Audit samples ChatGPT and Claude responses; Website Visibility Audit assesses page readiness.
- **Planning:** Comms Planner and Marketing Intelligence support schedules, prioritisation and opportunity research.
- **Content:** Content Creator, Content Optimiser & Editor and Content Library support drafting, revision and saved work.
- **Media research:** Media Research and Media Database support contact discovery, source review and outreach records.
- **Reporting:** Measure & Report combines saved audits, assessments, plan scores and recorded earned-media activity.

ChatGPT and Claude coverage refers to response-based visibility measurements, not every tool. Observed mentions and returned citations are distinct from generated authority or readiness assessments, content scores and predicted planning impact. Visibility improvements, rankings, recommendations and citations are not guaranteed; changes over time do not prove causal impact.
